Job.Description:
• Develop and manage procurement strategies for MEP systems, ensuring alignment with project timelines and budgets.
  • Conduct detailed market analysis to identify and evaluate potential suppliers, fostering strong supplier relationships.
  • Prepare and issue Requests for Quotation (RFQs), ensuring clarity in technical specifications and commercial terms.
  • Negotiate contracts with suppliers, aiming for the best value while maintaining quality standards and delivery timelines.

Company.Name: PME Elctor-Mechanical Works
Company.Profile: PME is an MEP contracting company based in Dubai since 5 years

Other.Keywords: Risk Assessment,Procurement Manager,MEP Buyer,Purchasing Engineer,Vendor Management,Purchasing Manager,Contract Administration,Supply Chain Engineer

DesiredCandidate.Profile:
• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Civil Engineering, with a strong foundation in MEP systems.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in procurement, specifically within the MEP or construction industry.
  • Professional certifications such as Certified Purchasing Professional (CPP) or similar are highly desirable.
  • Experience with procurement software and tools, enhancing efficiency in supply chain management.

jobHighlights: Develop procurement strategies for MEP systems
Conduct market analysis to evaluate suppliers
Prepare and issue RFQs with technical specifications
Negotiate supplier contracts and delivery timelines
